message:
Add support for WebAssembly builds of some 3p-packages (#284)

## What does this PR do?

Allow to build several 3p package to the WebAssembly target thanks to
emscripten compiler

Related to :
- https://github.com/o3de/o3de/issues/19083
- https://github.com/guillaume-haerinck/o3de/tree/emscripten

What remains :
- Emscripten should likely be a 3p-package itself so that users can
target WebAssembly without the need of installing emscripten by themself
- Need to have all 3p required by the engine/game (and not editor) built
with emscripten so that we can build the engine/game itself to
WebAssembly

## How was this PR tested?

Local build on windows. 

Setup required for now:
- Install
[emscripten](https://emscripten.org/docs/getting_started/downloads.html)
- Install [Ninja build
system](https://github.com/ninja-build/ninja/wiki/Pre-built-Ninja-packages)

Steps:
- Clone this repository and
[3p-package-script](https://github.com/o3de/3p-package-scripts) next to
each other
- From the 3p package scripts folder, open a terminal and run `python
.\build_package.py --search_path ..\..\3p-package-source
Lua-5.4.4-rev1-emscripten`
- Build exit successfully
- Unzip the created package and check that it is correct
- (near future) [Link
package](https://github.com/o3de/o3de/blob/development/cmake/3rdParty/Platform/Windows/BuiltInPackages_windows.cmake)
against o3de and build tests in webassembly (just need to create a wasm
folder in the cloned repo and run `emcmake cmake ..
-DLY_3RDPARTY_PATH=YOUR_PATH` then build the test targets)

Fixed lz4 linux build commands to build a static library

Due to the changes that the previous commit made from switching from building using `make` to building using `cmake` setting the `BUILD_SHARED_LIBS` option to `OFF` was missed

This resulted in a shared library being built for linux instead of a static library.

The other platforms uses the build_config.json common cmake generate arguments which set BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF and they were correctly built as a static library.
